text: The prompt runner awaits the first authentication result, cancels that first prompt if it rejects and removes the pending key. It then calls each queued consumer inside its own try/catch; a throwing consumer is logged without skipping later consumers. Finally it decrements the in-progress count and starts the next prompt. 1020 preserves those control-flow boundaries while improving logs; current code uses lazy.log.error. This is source knowledge about shared prompt fan-out, not a new concurrency test.
title: Continue notifying queued prompt consumers when one consumer throws
